report:
Screening Summary: The individual reports no difficulties with reading, writing, or spelling, and feels confident and comfortable performing everyday literacy tasks (e.g., reading menus, filling out forms, writing emails) without needing extra time or support. No indicators of dyslexia-related challenges were identified based on self-report.

Recommended Next Step: Based on the information provided, a formal dyslexia screening does not appear necessary at this time. If the individual notices any emerging difficulties in the future â€” such as trouble with reading fluency, spelling, or written expression â€” they are encouraged to reach out to the Dyslexia Association of Singapore for a follow-up screening. No further action needed at this time.
